definitions.gloss: the very best; the utmost; optimal
definitions.explanation: The best possible option, effort, or outcome in a given situation. Often used to express doing everything one can or choosing the best course of action.

examples.japanese: {最善|さいぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{最善|さいぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think this is the best method.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{最善|さいぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}さ→下す：12329_kudasu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: You must make the best possible judgment within the limited time available.

notes:
USAGE:
{最善|さいぜん} means "the very best" and is most commonly used in set phrases rather than standing alone. It carries a nuance of making the best of a situation or putting forth maximum effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最善|さいぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ (to do one's utmost)
- {最善|さいぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ (the best method)
- {最善|さいぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧ (the best plan/strategy)
- {最善|さいぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (the best judgment)
- {最善|さいぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧ (the best choice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最善|さいぜん}: the very best (often implies effort or optimization)
- ⟦{最良|さいりょう}→最良：18491_sairyou⟧: the finest, the best quality
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧: the highest, the greatest (broader and more casual)
- ⟦ベスト→ベスト：04681_besuto⟧: best (loanword, casual)
